twoStepFlag.description: Two-step flag. If 1, the clock uses two-step timestamps (separate FollowUp message).

priority1.description: Clock priority 1 (0–255); used in best master clock algorithm. Lower = higher priority.

priority2.description: Clock priority 2 (0–255); used if priority1 values tie. Lower = higher priority.

domainNumber.description: PTP domain number (0–127). Must match between master and slave devices.

logAnnounceInterval.description: Log2 of the interval between ANNOUNCE messages (default 1s).

logSyncInterval.description: Log2 of the interval between SYNC messages (default 2^0 = 1s).

logMinDelayReqInterval.description: Log2 of the minimum interval between delay request messages (default 2^0 = 1s).

logging_level.description: Global logging verbosity (0=debug to 7=emerg). Lower numbers = more verbose.

transportSpecific.description: Transport-specific header byte in hexadecimal (e.g., '0x0' for Ethernet).
